tech.hubIntro: All wireless earbuds sorted by technology: noise cancellation, USB-C, multipoint, Bluetooth version and audio codecs.
tech.ancIntro: {count} tracked earbuds offer active noise cancellation, across {brandCount} brands. ANC actively cancels ambient noise using microphones and a counter-signal, rather than just blocking it physically.
tech.usbCIntro: {count} tracked earbuds charge over USB-C, across {brandCount} brands. USB-C has become the standard charging port, replacing micro-USB and, on some models, Lightning.
tech.multipointIntro: {count} tracked earbuds support multipoint, across {brandCount} brands. Multipoint keeps you connected to two Bluetooth devices at once — a laptop and a phone, for example — and switches between them automatically.
tech.bluetoothIntro: {count} tracked earbuds use Bluetooth {version}, across {brandCount} brands. The Bluetooth version affects range, connection stability, and sometimes power consumption.
tech.codecIntro: {count} tracked earbuds support the {name} codec, across {brandCount} brands. The audio codec determines how sound is compressed and streamed over Bluetooth from the source to the earbuds.
